name: Clarity Protocol
description_short: Governance and DAO toolkit for Cardano communities.
description_long: Governance infrastructure for Cardano projects and DAOs. Runs the full proposal lifecycle — off-chain polls, on-chain proposals with automated outcome execution, multi-stage ratification pipelines, and audit trails — with one-member-one-vote, token-weighted, and DRep/SPO delegation-weighted snapshots. Also covers treasury management with multi-sig and native asset support, staking portals, contributor reward programs, reputation and leaderboards, Discord sync, whitelabel branding, and an API/SDK. Used by teams including Cardano Builder DAO, Indigo Protocol, SundaeSwap, FluidTokens, and Intersect, which ran the Cardano Constitutional Convention vote on the platform.
